first.rationale: Onboarding simplification is the strongest current candidate because it directly addresses the completion decline and has previously produced durable activation and time-to-value gains. I would verify both onboarding records and compare them with the pricing record, since promotional pricing may counter the competitor but could add lower-quality demand without proven long-term retention value.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening the onboarding flow. The closest verified evidence showed completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, directly addressing both current declines while supporting sustainable revenue. SMB signup simplification also lifted activation and qualified revenue, though its slight retention decline and limited segment replication argue against an immediate broad rollout. Promotional pricing is rejected because its +18% qualified-revenue lift was paired with 30-day retention of -12% and failure through first renewal.
